summary.text: Roy Handley is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 93, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Ben Davis in a race with no incumbent. A rancher and school bus company owner from the Clinton area, he also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Roy Handley earned a high school diploma from Hellgate High School and an associate degree from Casper College in 1986, and his career experience includes working as a business owner, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Missoula County, has lived on a ranch near Clinton all his life, and owned and operated a cattle ranch and a school bus transportation company for 37 years.
Handley advanced unopposed from the June 4, 2024 Republican primary for House District 93 and lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Katie Sullivan, 61.9 percent to 38.1 percent.
In 2026 he again advanced unopposed from the Republican primary.

In the survey, Handley described himself as a fiscal conservative and listed maintaining public roads and strengthening schools, limiting county regulations and fees that raise housing costs, and protecting Montana's way of life among his key messages.
He named attracting and keeping businesses that provide good-paying jobs as his main policy interest.
